content.short: Chasm Network is a decentralized AI network designed to democratize the creation, deployment, and monetization of autonomous AI agents.
content.description: Chasm Network is a decentralized infrastructure that bridges blockchain technology with artificial intelligence to enable the transparent deployment of AI agents. By utilizing a network of 'Scouts' and 'Miners,' Chasm provides decentralized inference services that ensure AI interactions are verifiable and censorship-resistant. Built on Mantle, Chasm leverages the network's modular architecture to power scalable and cost-effective AI solutions for the broader decentralized ecosystem.
content.meta: Chasm Network is a decentralized AI agent network built on the Mantle ecosystem. Discover Chasm Network on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
